The control-verb rule strips tense/status from the complement it names (sk_begin_1, correctly bare), but says nothing about the activity one level deeper, while the Ongoing rule licenses the inceptive's activity complement as an Ongoing marker; the two combine into a top-level (Ongoing sk_tend_1) asserting an in-progress tending that the sentence only licenses as permitted.
notes: The object-control routing (matrix permit event, complement begin reified at top level and attached by Theme, the object controller supplying the complement's Agent and appearing on no matrix role) and the inception shape (Theme = activity, Ongoing on it) both follow the instruction set, as does treating 'The Council' as a capitalized common noun with no Name atom and emitting no tense atom for the simple present.
